formulas.name: Radix-2 FFT
notes: Where: N = number of points (a power of 2)
Tip: N = 1024: DFT needs ~10⁶ multiplications; FFT ~5120.

formulas.name: DIT vs DIF
f: DIT: input in bit-reversed order, output natural
notes: Tip: Bit reversal of index 1 (001) in N = 8 → 4 (100).

formulas.name: FIR window design
notes: Tip: Better stopband → wider transition band; Kaiser window lets you trade both.

formulas.name: Chebyshev order
notes: Tip: Lower order than Butterworth for the same spec (ripple in passband).

formulas.name: Adaptive delta modulation
f: Step size increases during slope overload and decreases in flat
notes: Tip: Reduces both slope overload and granular noise compared with fixed DM.

formulas.name: FDM
f: Total bandwidth = Σ channel bandwidths + guard bands
notes: Tip: Each signal gets its own frequency slot (radio, cable TV).

formulas.name: TDM
f: Frame = one sample from each channel
bit rate = N × n × f<sub>s</sub> (+framing bits)
notes: Tip: T1: 24 channels × 8 bits × 8000 + 8000 framing = 1.544 Mbps.

formulas.name: Network topologies
f: Bus, star, ring, mesh (links = n(n −1)2), tree, hybrid
notes: Tip: Star is most common (easy fault isolation); mesh most reliable.
